title: The Prognostic Value of ASPHD1 and ZBTB12 in Colorectal Cancer: A Machine Learning-Based Integrated Bioinformatics Approach.
summary: Publisher full text read in Chrome, Methods and Results: transcriptomic ML analysis of colorectal-cancer samples nominated ASPHD1/ZBTB12 prognostic markers; follow-up qPCR in 64 samples and whole-exome validation in 15 samples. Specific gene-marker associations with experimental validation, but small validation subsets and observational evidence do not establish clinical utility.
ai_technology: Transcriptomic machine-learning analysis ranked colorectal-cancer prognostic markers, which were checked with qPCR and whole-exome data.
